summary: Comprehensive manhwa recap niche analysis with competitor data from NexLev. Covers 11 competitor channels found via get_similar_channels, revenue comparisons across 3 channels (1221Recap, Manhwa Outpost, ZERO Manhwa Recap), exposes NexLev data quality issues (identical RPM/demographics across same-category channels proving category-level estimation), identifies content farm operations (copy-paste descriptions between channels), analyzes boom-and-bust cycle (Manhwa Outpost with 405K subs making only $1,045/month while 1221Recap with 19K subs makes $5,524), and delivers a blunt DECLINE recommendation with 7 specific reasons why the user's constraints make this a bad fit.
